notes: Pull reader; events track whether it is inside a price or description element. Since 0.38 text references are separate events, resolved with resolve_char_ref and resolve_predefined_entity.
details: Pull reader. Start, end, text, CDATA and GeneralRef events track whether the reader is inside a price or description element. The stock attribute is read with Attribute::normalized_value. A reference in text is its own event since 0.38, so the adapter resolves it with the crate's resolve_char_ref and escape::resolve_predefined_entity; text is read with BytesText::xml10_content.
